name: subagents
description: Automatically delegates matching Pi tasks to Markdown-configured subagents.

scripts.check: bun run check:syntax && bun run eval:conversation-context
scripts.check:syntax: node --experimental-strip-types --check index.ts agents.ts runtime/*.ts ui/*.ts evals/orchestration/run.ts evals/orchestration/cases.ts evals/conversation-context/run.ts
scripts.eval: bun run eval:conversation-context && bun run eval:orchestration
